qualifications: This is a catalog census of all nine visible non-system schemas. It is not a byte-for-byte dump of every managed Supabase object definition.

The pre-existing public-schema exports provide the detailed public application catalog. Managed schemas are inventoried here by relation names and schema-level object counts; their internal definitions are owned by Supabase and are not proposed for modification.
The 130 public relations comprise 114 tables/partitioned tables, 13 views and 3 materialized views.
The 36 trigger count is non-internal triggers; internal PostgreSQL triggers are excluded.
No application table rows were read as part of this catalog census. Schema and permission metadata only.
The public schema's existing detailed baseline files are the authoritative detailed public-schema export for this sprint.
